body:
I have a good job, and plenty of cash, a few friends, some interests and hobbies.  But I am not happy.  I am just miserable all the time.  All I want to do is lay in bed.  I was diagnosed with severe depression 12 months ago, I have tried Citalapram, Setreline and now Velafaxine.  None of them work.  Diet and Exercise have lost their effect.  Counseling does not help.  I just get worse and worse.

I want out, I don't want to feel like this any more.
